{{Top|leg}}
The '''Awards Hall''' was a room within the [[Eanca Goa-Ato]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Hunters' Guild]] Hall on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. 

The Awards Hall had shrines commemorating those Rodian hunters who had been awarded one of the [[Species/Legends|species]]' annual hunting awards, [[Atiang/Legends|Atiang]]; initially it housed written and video accounts that verified the exploits of the prize's holders, but as the process became more sophisticated, it included recorded testimonies, even recordings of the event itself; over the centuries it was expanded and the Eanca Goa-Ato complex grew around it.

The room was open in the morning for the Guild members, and during the afternoon of each [[Standard day/Legends|day]] it was open to all visitors.
